local function computeLadderVelocity(p1, p2, p3, p4) --[[ computeLadderVelocity | Line: 497 | Upvalues: getViewBasis (copy) ]]
	local LadderSpeed = p4.LadderSpeed

	if p1.Duck or p1.Walk then
		LadderSpeed = LadderSpeed * p4.LadderClimbModifier
	end

	local v4 = math.clamp(-p1.MoveVector.Y, -1, 1) * LadderSpeed
	local v5 = math.clamp(p1.MoveVector.X, -1, 1) * LadderSpeed

	if math.abs(v4) <= 1e-6 and math.abs(v5) <= 1e-6 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end

	local v6, v7 = getViewBasis(p1.LookYaw, p1.VerticalLook)
	local v8 = v6 * v4 + v7 * v5
	local v9 = (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)):Cross(p2)
	local v10 = if v9.Magnitude <= 1e-6 then Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) else v9.Unit
	local v11 = p2:Cross(v10)
	local v12 = v8:Dot(p2)
	local v13 = p2 * v12
	local v14 = v8 - v13
	local v15 = v11:Dot(v14)
	local v16 = v10:Dot(v14)
	local v17 = v10 * v16 + v13

	if v17.Magnitude > 1e-6 and v17.Unit:Dot(p2) < p4.LadderDampenAngle then
		v14 = v11 * v15 + v10 * (p4.LadderDampen * v16)
	end

	local sum = (v14 - v11 * v12) * p4.LadderLateralScale

	if p3 and v12 > 0 then
		sum = sum + p2 * p4.LadderSpeed
	end

	return sum
end

local function hasAimMovedSinceLastSend(p1, p2) --[[ hasAimMovedSinceLastSend | Line: 265 ]]

	if typeof(LastSentLookYaw) ~= "number" then
		return true
	end

	if math.abs((p2.LookYaw - LastSentLookYaw + math.pi) % 6.283185307179586 - math.pi) > 0.006 then

	end

local function resolveCorrectedPositionAgainstLocalWorld(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6) --[[ resolveCorrectedPositionAgainstLocalWorld | Line: 933 | Upvalues: v5 (copy), Diagnostics (copy) ]]

local function generateLocalPointsForPrimitive(p1, p2) --[[ generateLocalPointsForPrimitive | Line: 93 | Upvalues: findShapeForInstance (copy), t3 (copy), t4 (copy), t2 (copy) ]]
	local v1 = findShapeForInstance(p1)

	if v1 == Enum.PartType.Wedge then
		local t = {}

		for i, v in ipairs(t3) do
			table.insert(t, v * p2)
		end

		return t
	end

	if v1 == Enum.PartType.CornerWedge then
		local t = {}

		for i, v in ipairs(t4) do
			table.insert(t, v * p2)
		end

		return t
	end

	if v1 == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then
		local v2 = p2.X * 0.5
		local v3 = math.min(p2.Y, p2.Z) * 0.5
		local t = {}

		for i = 0, 11 do
			local v4 = i / 12 * math.pi * 2
			local v5 = math.cos(v4) * v3
			local v6 = math.sin(v4) * v3

			table.insert(t, (Vector3.new(-v2, v5, v6)))
			table.insert(t, (Vector3.new(v2, v5, v6)))
		end

		return t
	end

	if v1 == Enum.PartType.Ball then
		local v9 = math.min(p2.X, p2.Y, p2.Z) * 0.5
		local t = {
			Vector3.new(v9, 0, 0),
			Vector3.new(-v9, 0, 0),
			Vector3.new(0, v9, 0),
			Vector3.new(0, -v9, 0),
			Vector3.new(0, 0, v9),
			(Vector3.new(0, 0, -v9))
		}

		for j = 1, 8 do
			local v10 = j / 9 * math.pi
			local v11 = math.sin(v10) * v9
			local v12 = math.cos(v10) * v9

			for k = 0, 15 do
				local v13 = k / 16 * math.pi * 2
				local v14 = math.cos(v13) * v11
				local v15 = math.sin(v13) * v11

				table.insert(t, (Vector3.new(v12, v14, v15)))
				table.insert(t, (Vector3.new(-v12, v14, v15)))
			end
		end

		return t
	end

	local t = {}

	for i, v in ipairs(t2) do
		table.insert(t, v * p2)
	end

	return t
end

local function findPointBounds(p1) --[[ findPointBounds | Line: 228 ]]

local function addPlane(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5) --[[ addPlane | Line: 281 ]]
	for i, v in ipairs(p1) do
		local v1

		v1 = if (v.n - p2).Magnitude <= 0.001 then if math.abs(v.ed - p3) <= 0.001 then true else false else false

		if v1 then
			return false
		end
	end

	table.insert(p1, {
		n = p2,
		ed = p3,
		planeNum = p4,
		minkowskiPlaneKind = p5
	})

	return true
end

local function buildPlanesForPoints(p1, p2) --[[ buildPlanesForPoints | Line: 319 | Upvalues: QuickHull (copy), addPlane (copy) ]]
	assert(if #p1 >= 4 then true else false, "A convex movement hull requires at least four points")

	local v2 = QuickHull.GenerateHull(p1)

	assert(if #v2 > 0 then true else false, "QuickHull returned no triangles")

	local t = {}

	for i, v in ipairs(v2) do
		local v4 = (v[1] - v[2]):Cross(v[1] - v[3])

		if v4.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			local Unit = v4.Unit

			if addPlane(t, Unit, v[1]:Dot(Unit), p2 + 1) then
				p2 = p2 + 1
				t[#t].planeNum = p2
			end
		end
	end

	assert(#t > 0, "QuickHull returned no usable planes")

	return t, p2
end

local function buildCylinderPlanes(p1, p2, p3) --[[ buildCylinderPlanes | Line: 343 | Upvalues: addPlane (copy) ]]
	local t = {}
	local Position = p1.Position
	local v1 = p2.X * 0.5
	local v2 = math.min(p2.Y, p2.Z) * 0.5
	local RightVector = p1.RightVector

	local function pushPlane(p1, p2) --[[ pushPlane | Line: 350 | Upvalues: addPlane (ref), t (copy), p3 (ref) ]]
		if p1.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
			return
		end

		local Unit = p1.Unit

		if not addPlane(t, Unit, p2:Dot(Unit), p3 + 1) then
			return
		end

		p3 = p3 + 1
		t[#t].planeNum = p3
	end

	local v3 = Position + RightVector * v1

	if not (RightVector.Magnitude <= 0.001) then
		local Unit = RightVector.Unit

		if addPlane(t, Unit, v3:Dot(Unit), p3 + 1) then
			p3 = p3 + 1
			t[#t].planeNum = p3
		end
	end

	local v4 = -RightVector
	local v5 = Position - RightVector * v1

	if not (v4.Magnitude <= 0.001) then
		local Unit = v4.Unit

		if addPlane(t, Unit, v5:Dot(Unit), p3 + 1) then
			p3 = p3 + 1
			t[#t].planeNum = p3
		end
	end

	for i = 0, 11 do
		local v6 = i / 12 * math.pi * 2
		local v9 = p1:VectorToWorldSpace((Vector3.new(0, math.cos(v6), (math.sin(v6)))))
		local v10 = Position + v9 * v2

		if not (v9.Magnitude <= 0.001) then
			local Unit = v9.Unit

			if addPlane(t, Unit, v10:Dot(Unit), p3 + 1) then
				p3 = p3 + 1
				t[#t].planeNum = p3
			end
		end
	end

	return t, p3
end

local function isAxisAlignedBlockPart(p1, p2, p3) --[[ isAxisAlignedBlockPart | Line: 413 ]]

	end

	for i, v in ipairs({ p3.RightVector, p3.UpVector, p3.LookVector }) do

		end
	end

	return true

local function buildOrientedBlockPlanes(p1, p2, p3, p4) --[[ buildOrientedBlockPlanes | Line: 470 | Upvalues: addPlane (copy), t5 (copy) ]]
	local Position = p1.Position
	local v1 = p2 * 0.5
	local list = {
		{
			direction = p1.RightVector,
			halfSpan = v1.X
		},
		{
			direction = p1.UpVector,
			halfSpan = v1.Y
		},
		{
			direction = p1.LookVector,
			halfSpan = v1.Z
		}
	}
	local t = {}

	local function pushPlane(p1, p2) --[[ pushPlane | Line: 485 | Upvalues: Position (copy), p3 (copy), list (copy), addPlane (ref), t (copy), p4 (ref) ]]
		if p1.Magnitude <= p2 then
			return
		end

		local Unit = p1.Unit
		local v1 = Unit:Dot(Position)
		local v2 = v1 + math.abs(Unit.X) * p3.X
		local v3 = v2 + math.abs(Unit.Y) * p3.Y
		local sum = v3 + math.abs(Unit.Z) * p3.Z

		for i, v in ipairs(list) do
			sum = sum + math.abs((Unit:Dot(v.direction))) * v.halfSpan
		end

		if not addPlane(t, Unit, sum, p4 + 1) then
			return
		end

		p4 = p4 + 1
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(list) do
		pushPlane(v.direction, 0.001)
		pushPlane(-v.direction, 0.001)
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(t5) do
		pushPlane(v, 0.001)
		pushPlane(-v, 0.001)
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(list) do
		for i2, v2 in ipairs(t5) do
			local v22 = v.direction:Cross(v2)

			pushPlane(v22, 0.02)
			pushPlane(-v22, 0.02)
		end
	end

	return t, p4
end

local function buildLocalHullMinkowskiPlanes(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5) --[[ buildLocalHullMinkowskiPlanes | Line: 527 | Upvalues: QuickHull (copy), addPlane (copy), t5 (copy) ]]
	local list = {}

	for i, v in ipairs((QuickHull.GenerateHull(p2))) do
		local v2 = (v[1] - v[2]):Cross(v[1] - v[3])

		if v2.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			local Unit = v2.Unit
			local v3 = true

			for i2, v4 in ipairs(list) do
				if (v4 - Unit).Magnitude <= 0.001 then
					v3 = false

					break
				end
			end

			if v3 then
				table.insert(list, Unit)
			end
		end
	end

	local t = {}

	local function pushPlane(p1, p2, p32) --[[ pushPlane | Line: 554 | Upvalues: p3 (copy), p4 (copy), addPlane (ref), t (copy), p5 (ref) ]]
		if p1.Magnitude <= p2 then
			return
		end

		local Unit = p1.Unit
		local v1 = (-1 / 0)

		for i, v in ipairs(p3) do
			v1 = math.max(v1, v:Dot(Unit))
		end

		local v3 = math.abs(Unit.X) * p4.X
		local v4 = v3 + math.abs(Unit.Y) * p4.Y

		if not addPlane(t, Unit, v1 + (v4 + math.abs(Unit.Z) * p4.Z), p5 + 1, p32) then
			return
		end

		p5 = p5 + 1
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(list) do
		pushPlane(p1:VectorToWorldSpace(v), 0.001, "sourceFace")
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(t5) do
		pushPlane(v, 0.001, "playerAxis")
		pushPlane(-v, 0.001, "playerAxis")
	end

	for i = 1, #list do
		for j = i + 1, #list do
			local v4 = list[i]:Cross(list[j])

			if v4.Magnitude > 0.02 then
				local v5 = p1:VectorToWorldSpace(v4.Unit)

				for i2, v in ipairs(t5) do
					local v6 = v5:Cross(v)

					pushPlane(v6, 0.02, "edgeBevel")
					pushPlane(-v6, 0.02, "edgeBevel")
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return t, p5
end

function t5.doAdjacentMerge(p1, p2, p3) --[[ doAdjacentMerge | Line: 734 ]]
	local edge = p2.edge
	local count = 0
	local v1 = true

	while true do
		if p2.nVertices < count then
			error("merge recursion limit exceeded")
		end

		local face = edge.opposite.face
		local v2 = false

		if p3 == 2 then
			v2 = if p1:oppositeFaceDistance(edge) > -p1.tolerance then true elseif p1:oppositeFaceDistance(edge.opposite) > p1.tolerance then true else false

			if p1:oppositeFaceDistance(edge) > -p1.tolerance then
				v2 = true
			elseif p1:oppositeFaceDistance(edge.opposite) > -p1.tolerance then
				v1 = false
			end
		elseif p1:oppositeFaceDistance(edge.opposite) > -p1.tolerance then
			v2 = true
		elseif p1:oppositeFaceDistance(edge) > -p1.tolerance then
			v1 = false
		end

		if v2 then
			for i, v in ipairs((p2:mergeAdjacentFaces(edge, {}))) do
				p1:deleteFaceVertices(v, p2)
			end

			return true
		end

		edge = edge.next

		if edge == p2.edge then
			if v1 then
				return false
			end

			p2.mark = 1

			return false
		end

	end

function t5.addVertexToHull(p1, p2) --[[ addVertexToHull | Line: 785 ]]

			repeat

			until not p1:doAdjacentMerge(v, 1)
		end
	end

	for i, v in ipairs(p1.newFaces) do
		if v.mark == 1 then
			v.mark = 0

			repeat

			until not p1:doAdjacentMerge(v, 2)
		end
	end

end
function t5.build(p1) --[[ build | Line: 810 ]]

		return false
	end

	local v1 = p1:nextVertexToAdd()

	while v1 do
		p1:addVertexToHull(v1)
		v1 = p1:nextVertexToAdd()
	end

	p1:reindexFaceAndVertices()

	return true
end
function t5.GenerateHull(p1) --[[ GenerateHull | Line: 825 | Upvalues: t5 (copy) ]]

		end

		end

function t.getDivergenceReason(p1, p2, p3) --[[ getDivergenceReason | Line: 189 | Upvalues: t (copy) ]]
	local v1 = t.buildFromState(p1, p3)

	if v1.MovementType ~= p2.MovementType then
		return "MovementTypeDivergence"
	end

	if v1.OnGround ~= p2.OnGround then
		return "GroundStateDivergence"
	end

	if v1.OnGround and v1.GroundSupportIsDynamicPlayer ~= p2.GroundSupportIsDynamicPlayer then
		return "GroundStateDivergence"
	end

	if v1.MovementType == "Ladder" then
		local WallNormal = v1.WallNormal
		local WallNormal2 = p2.WallNormal
		local v2 = WallNormal.Magnitude > 0.05
		local v3 = if WallNormal2.Magnitude > 0.05 then true else false

		if if v2 == v3 then if v2 then if WallNormal.Unit:Dot(WallNormal2.Unit) < 0.995 then true else false else false else true then
			return "WallStateDivergence"
		end
	end

	if math.abs(v1.DuckAmount - p2.DuckAmount) > 0.05 then
		return "DuckStateDivergence"
	end

	if math.abs(v1.DuckTimeMsecs - p2.DuckTimeMsecs) > 50 then
		return "DuckStateDivergence"
	end

	if v1.DuckHeld ~= p2.DuckHeld then
		return "DuckStateDivergence"
	end

	if math.abs(v1.DuckFatigueLevel - p2.DuckFatigueLevel) > 10 then
		return "DuckStateDivergence"
	end

	if math.abs(v1.DuckFatigueTimerMsecs - p2.DuckFatigueTimerMsecs) > 50 then
		return "DuckStateDivergence"
	end

	if math.abs(v1.Stamina - p2.Stamina) > 1 then
		return "StaminaDivergence"
	end

	if math.abs(v1.LastJumpTick - p2.LastJumpTick) > 4 then
		return "JumpStateDivergence"
	end

	if v1.JumpHeld ~= p2.JumpHeld then
		return "JumpStateDivergence"
	end

	if v1.JumpBufferTicksRemaining ~= p2.JumpBufferTicksRemaining then
		return "JumpStateDivergence"
	end

	if v1.JumpHullActive == p2.JumpHullActive then
		return nil
	end

	return "JumpStateDivergence"
end

function t.Resolve(p1, p2) --[[ Resolve | Line: 75 ]]

		return p1.ResolvedDown

local function getMovementAnimationFromVelocity(p1, p2) --[[ getMovementAnimationFromVelocity | Line: 304 | Upvalues: t2 (copy) ]]

	local t = {}

	t[2] = if v4 < -0.3 then "B" else ""
	t[3] = if v3 < -0.3 then "L" else ""
	t[4] = if v3 > 0.3 then "R" else ""

function t.Prepare(p1) --[[ Prepare | Line: 411 | Upvalues: t (copy), v1 (copy), prepare (copy) ]]
	if t.IsPrepared(p1) then
		return true
	end

	repeat
		if not v1[p1] then
			v1[p1] = true

			local ok, result = pcall(prepare, p1)

			v1[p1] = nil

			if not ok then
				error(result, 0)
			end

			return result
		end

		task.wait()

		if t.IsPrepared(p1) then
			return true
		end
	until not p1.Parent

	return false
end

function t.ApplyImpulse(p1, p2) --[[ ApplyImpulse | Line: 564 | Upvalues: GetWeaponProperties (copy), PartMultipliers (copy), BodyParts (copy) ]]
	local v1 = p1:FindFirstChild(p2.Part)

	if not (v1 and v1:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return
	end

	local v2 = GetWeaponProperties(p2.Weapon)

	if not v2 then
		return
	end

	local Direction = p2.Direction
	local v3 = if typeof(Direction) == "Vector3" then Direction.Magnitude else 0
	local v4 = if v3 == v3 and not (v3 < 0.001) then Direction / v3 else Vector3.new(-0, -1, -0)
	local v6 = (v2.RagdollMultiplier or 45) * (if typeof(p2.DirectionMultiplier) == "number" then p2.DirectionMultiplier else 1)
	local v7 = PartMultipliers[v1.Name]
	local v8 = if v7 then v6 * (math.random(v7.Minimum, v7.Maximum) / 100) else v6
	local v10 = (if v1.Name == "Head" then 1 else 0) + 2.5

	v1.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (v4 * v8 + Vector3.new(-0, -5, -0)) * v10

	local v11 = (v4 * v6 + Vector3.new(-0, -5, -0)) * v10 * 0.1

	for v12, v13 in p1:GetChildren() do
		if v13:IsA("BasePart") and (v13 ~= v1 and (BodyParts[v13.Name] ~= nil and not (v13.Anchored or v13:HasTag("CharacterAccessory")))) then
			v13.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v13.AssemblyLinearVelocity + v11
		end
	end
end
function t.DisableJoint(p1, p2) --[[ DisableJoint | Line: 612 ]]
	local RagdollJoints = p1:FindFirstChild("RagdollJoints")

	if not (RagdollJoints and RagdollJoints:IsA("Folder")) then
		return
	end

	for v2, v3 in RagdollJoints:GetChildren() do
		local v1
		local Motor = v3:FindFirstChild("Motor")

		v1 = if Motor and Motor:IsA("ObjectValue") then Motor.Value else nil

		if v1 and (v1:IsA("Motor6D") and v1.Name == p2) then
			for v4, v5 in v3:GetDescendants() do
				if v5:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or v5:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
					v5.Enabled = false
				end
			end

			return
		end
	end
end

local function processPendingSnapshotBatch(p1) --[[ processPendingSnapshotBatch | Line: 1304 | Upvalues: t2 (copy), SnapshotCharacterGeneration (copy), consumeSnapshotBatch (copy) ]]
	if t2[p1.Player] ~= p1 or p1.Player.Character ~= p1.Shell then
		return false
	end

	local PendingSnapshotBatch = p1.PendingSnapshotBatch
	local PendingSnapshotGeneration = p1.PendingSnapshotGeneration
	local PendingSnapshotReceivedAt = p1.PendingSnapshotReceivedAt

	if PendingSnapshotBatch == nil or (PendingSnapshotGeneration == nil or PendingSnapshotReceivedAt == nil) then
		return true
	end

	if os.clock() - PendingSnapshotReceivedAt > 2 then
		p1.PendingSnapshotBatch = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotGeneration = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotReceivedAt = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotNewestTick = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotHasTeleport = nil
	else
		if SnapshotCharacterGeneration.Get(p1.Shell) ~= PendingSnapshotGeneration then
			return true
		end

		p1.PendingSnapshotBatch = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotGeneration = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotReceivedAt = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotNewestTick = nil
		p1.PendingSnapshotHasTeleport = nil
		consumeSnapshotBatch(p1.Player, PendingSnapshotBatch, PendingSnapshotReceivedAt)

		if t2[p1.Player] ~= p1 or p1.Player.Character ~= p1.Shell then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

		return 0
	end

	local Position = p1.Position

	if (v1 - Position).Magnitude > VerticalMagnetism.MaxDistance then
		return 0
	end

	local v5 = math.asin((math.clamp((v1 - Position).Unit.Y, -1, 1))) - v3

		return 0
	end

		v2 = "Hold"
	end

	if v2 == "Toggle" then
		if p1 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			CharacterController.walk(not (CharacterController.GetWalkState() or false))
		end
	else
		if p1 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			CharacterController.walk(true)

			return
		end

		if p1 == Enum.UserInputState.End then
			CharacterController.walk(false)
		end
	end
end

	Name = "Walk",
	Group = "Default",
	Category = "Movement Keys",
	BindPriority = v1,
	Callback = onInput

function t.scope(p1, p2) --[[ scope | Line: 800 | Upvalues: v1 (copy), LocalPlayer (copy), CameraController (copy), Constants (copy), t2 (copy), Remotes (copy) ]]

	end

function t.setupRecoil(p1) --[[ setupRecoil | Line: 2226 | Upvalues: RunServiceController (copy), CameraController (copy) ]]
	local Recoil = p1.Properties.Recoil

	if not p1.Properties.Recoil then
		return
	end

	local RecoverySpeed = Recoil.RecoverySpeed
	local Scale = Recoil.Scale
	local Damper = Recoil.Damper
	local Speed = Recoil.Speed
	local CameraScale = Recoil.CameraScale
	local Identifier = p1.Identifier
	local v1 = Recoil.Pattern(p1.Properties)

	p1.Recoil = {
		RotationValue = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
		Time = 0,
		RecoveryTime = 0,
		RecoveryStartTime = 0,
		Function = v1,
		Functions = {
			Default = v1
		},
		Value = Vector2.zero,
		ActiveFireRate = p1.Properties.FireRate or 0.1,
		RecoveryValue = Vector2.zero
	}

	local Recoil2 = p1.Recoil

	p1.Janitor:Add(RunServiceController.BindToStepped(("Components.Weapon.%*.Recoil"):format(p1.Identifier), function(p12, p2) --[[ Line: 2259 | Upvalues: p1 (copy), Recoil2 (copy), RecoverySpeed (copy), Scale (copy), Identifier (copy), CameraController (ref), Damper (copy), Speed (copy), CameraScale (copy) ]]
		if p1.IsDestroyed or not (Recoil2 and p1.IsEquipped) then
			return
		end

		local v1 = Recoil2.Function(Recoil2.Time)

		if p1.IsShooting then
			Recoil2.Value = v1
			Recoil2.RecoveryValue = v1
			Recoil2.RecoveryTime = Recoil2.Time
			Recoil2.RecoveryStartTime = os.clock()
		else
			local v2 = Recoil2.RecoveryValue.Magnitude / RecoverySpeed

			if Recoil2.Value.Magnitude > 0 and v2 > 0 then
				Recoil2.Value = Recoil2.RecoveryValue:Lerp(Vector2.zero, (math.clamp((os.clock() - Recoil2.RecoveryStartTime) / v2, 0, 1)))
			end

			if Recoil2.Time > 0 then
				Recoil2.Time = math.max(Recoil2.Time - Recoil2.RecoveryTime * RecoverySpeed * p2, 0)
			end
		end

		local v6 = Vector3.new(Recoil2.Value.Y, Recoil2.Value.X, 0)
		local v8 = v6 * math.rad(Scale)

		Recoil2.RotationValue = v8

		if p1.IsDestroyed or (not p1.IsEquipped or p1.Identifier ~= Identifier) then
			return
		end

		CameraController.setWeaponRecoil({
			Value = v8,
			Damper = Damper,
			Speed = Speed
		}, CameraScale)
	end), "Disconnect", "RecoilConnection")
end

local function DefineNamespace(p1, p2) --[[ DefineNamespace | Line: 15 | Upvalues: RunService (copy), ReplicatedStorage (copy) ]]
	if RunService:IsClient() then
		ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NetworkRemotes"):WaitForChild(p1)
	end

	local t = {}

	for k, v in pairs((p2())) do
		if type(v) == "function" then
			t[k] = v(p1, k)

			continue
		end

		t[k] = v
	end

	return table.freeze(t)
end

local t = {}

t.__index = t

local exp = math.exp
local sin = math.sin
local cos = math.cos

function t.new(p1, p2, p3) --[[ new | Line: 21 | Upvalues: t (copy) ]]
	assert(if type(p1) == "number" then true else false, "damping ratio must be a number")
	assert(if type(p2) == "number" then true else false, "frequency must be a number")
	assert(if p1 * p2 >= 0 then true else false, "Spring does not converge")

	return setmetatable({
		d = p1,
		f = p2 * 0.2,
		g = p3,
		p = p3,
		v = p3 * 0
	}, t)
end

end

	p1.p = p1.g
	p1.v = p1.g * 0

function t.update(p1, p2) --[[ update | Line: 73 | Upvalues: exp (copy), sqrt (copy), cos (copy), sin (copy) ]]
	local d = p1.d
	local v1 = p1.f * 2 * math.pi
	local g = p1.g
	local v = p1.v
	local v2 = p1.p - g
	local v3 = exp(-d * v1 * p2)
	local v4, v5

	if d == 1 then
		v4 = (v2 * (1 + v1 * p2) + v * p2) * v3 + g
		v5 = (v * (1 - v1 * p2) - v2 * (v1 * v1 * p2)) * v3
	elseif d < 1 then
		local v6 = sqrt(1 - d * d)
		local v7 = cos(v1 * v6 * p2)
		local v8 = sin(v1 * v6 * p2)
		local v9

		if v6 > 0.0001 then
			v9 = v8 / v6
		else
			local v10 = p2 * v1

			v9 = v10 + (v10 * v10 * (v6 * v6) * (v6 * v6) / 20 - v6 * v6) * (v10 * v10 * v10) / 6
		end

		local v11

		if v1 * v6 > 0.0001 then
			v11 = v8 / (v1 * v6)
		else
			local v12 = v1 * v6

			v11 = p2 + (p2 * p2 * (v12 * v12) * (v12 * v12) / 20 - v12 * v12) * (p2 * p2 * p2) / 6
		end

		v4 = (v2 * (v7 + d * v9) + v * v11) * v3 + g
		v5 = (v * (v7 - v9 * d) - v2 * (v9 * v1)) * v3
	else
		local v13 = sqrt(d * d - 1)
		local v14 = -v1 * (d - v13)
		local v15 = -v1 * (d + v13)
		local v16 = (v - v2 * v14) / (2 * v1 * v13)
		local v17 = (v2 - v16) * exp(v14 * p2)
		local v18 = v16 * exp(v15 * p2)

		v4 = v17 + v18 + g
		v5 = v17 * v14 + v18 * v15
	end

	p1.p = v4
	p1.v = v5

	return v4
end
